mentions.name: Talking to Machines
mentions.description: Interactive AI course where concepts such as agents and context windows can be experienced and experimented with through fun widgets designed for learning by doing, aiming for depth of nuance and hands-on engagement.
mentions.problem: Existing AI courses lack hands-on experimentation and depth of nuance.
mentions.audience: Learners who want to understand AI concepts hands-on
mentions.source_excerpt:
Talking to Machines is an interactive AI course. 
Each concept be it agents or context window can be experienced and experimented with using fun little widgets designed to help you learn by doing.
mentions.author: DangerousYams
